name: How long does a window installation project usually take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a window installation project usually take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a window installation project depends on the number of windows, their type, and the complexity of the installation. For an average home, installing standard windows can take anywhere from one to three days. Larger projects or those involving custom windows or significant structural adjustments might take longer. We provide a projected timeline during the initial consultation.
acceptedAnswer.description: A typical window installation project for an average home can take one to three days, depending on the number and type of windows.
